Create a sprawling abandoned medieval stone city in a rugged mountain valley, divided by a winding pale turquoise river. Pack dozens of roofless buildings along narrow dirt lanes, courtyards, and stepped rocky ground on both banks, thinning toward the slopes. Mix gray masonry houses, halls, broken towers, and larger Gothic ruins with arches and partially collapsed stories. Connect the banks with a narrow arched stone bridge. Add stairs, retaining walls, rubble, logs, and scattered timber remains among the exposed room divisions. Shape rock shelves, cliffs, boulders, and gullies around the settlement, with irregular trees, scrub, grasses, and a few bare courtyards. Keep the layout organic and hazy under soft daylight.
